description: List the page trash, newest first. Each entry is one deleted group - a page plus the descendants deleted with it: id (the trash id restore_page takes), name, slug, deletedAt, deletedById and deletedByName, descendantCount, and expiresAt, when the group is deleted permanently (30 days after deletion). Only groups the caller holds pages:delete on are listed; without it the list is empty.
name: list_trashed_pages
title: List trashed pages
